name: Norfolk city, VA
findings: Norfolk city has 937 nonprofit organizations. 408 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 324 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Norfolk city has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
